name: CapCut AI hair transformation template tutorials
what_it_is: Videos promote and walk through CapCut's AI hair transformation template, which turns one photo into a salon-style makeover (short-to-long burgundy hair, dyeing and styling). Creators in English, French, Spanish and Burmese show step-by-step how to copy the video link, open the template, and apply the filter, often alongside CapCut Pro discount promos.
